description: Works out a dish's break-even price on a delivery app, the app price that leaves the owner the same money as selling it in their dining room, as the free delivery app price calculator on restaurantdoctorai.com does: the in-house price ÷ (1 − the app's real commission rate), the markup on the in-house price that takes (rounded up to a whole percent), and what the app keeps. Takes the dish's in-house price, in any currency, and one app's real commission rate from its payout statements; a figure that isn't sent is never counted as 0. Returns the calculator's result, how it was worked out, and a link that opens the calculator with the same figures filled in. The figures aren't stored; only an anonymous daily count of calculator runs is kept.

price.description: The dish's price on the owner's own menu, as a dining room guest pays it, in the owner's own currency (14 or 18.5). Required, and more than 0.

rate.description: One delivery app's real commission rate, as a percent: 30 for 30%, not 0.30. From a month of that app's payout statements: (menu sales before tax and tips − the app's payout without tax and tips) ÷ those menu sales × 100, so marketing fees, promotions the owner funds and refunds are in it; the rate in the app's plan leaves them out. Each app is worked out on its own. Required: 0, or from 1 to 89.

name: restaurantdoctor_delivery_price

appKeeps.description: What the app keeps at the break-even app price, to the cent as the page shows it.

appPrice.description: The break-even app price, price ÷ (1 − rate), to the cent as the page shows it: the app price that leaves the owner the in-house price.

link.description: Opens the calculator on the website with these figures filled in.

markupPercent.description: The markup on the in-house price that takes, %, rounded up to a whole number so it's never short.

price.description: The in-house price it was worked out from, in the currency it was sent in.

result.description: The result in the page's words, in its order.

workedOut.description: How it was worked out, with the figures in each step.

title: Delivery app price calculator
